title.en: Methods of preparing a trial balance

body.en: Totals method: the debit and credit totals of every account are listed. *Balance* method: only the net balance of each account is listed; this is the most commonly used method. Totals-cum-balance method: both totals and balances are shown. In every method the two columns must agree.

narration.en: A trial balance lists every ledger balance: debit balances (assets, expenses, purchases) on one side, credit balances (capital, sales, creditors) on the other. If every posting is complete, the totals agree. Leave out part of a posting and see the difference. Change sales and purchases. Why does it still agree? Miss ₹12 thousand of a cash posting. Where would you put the difference for now?
narration.kn: ತಾಳೆ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಖಾತೆ ಶಿಲ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ: ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಶಿಲ್ಕು (ಆಸ್ತಿ, ವೆಚ್ಚ, ಖರೀದಿ) ಒಂದು ಬದಿ, ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಶಿಲ್ಕು (ಬಂಡವಾಳ, ಮಾರಾಟ, ಸಾಲಗಾರ) ಇನ್ನೊಂದು. ಎಲ್ಲ ಖತಾವಣೆ ಸರಿಯಿದ್ದರೆ ಮೊತ್ತ ಸಮ. ಒಂದು ಭಾಗ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ನೋಡಿ. ಮಾರಾಟ ಮತ್ತು ಖರೀದಿ ಬದಲಿಸಿ. ಆದರೂ ಏಕೆ ಸಮ? ನಗದು ಖತಾವಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ₹12 ಸಾವಿರ ಬಿಡಿ. ಸದ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡುತ್ತೀರಿ?

say.en: Let us work this out together. From the following balances of Ganesh Traders on 31 March 2025, prepare a trial balance and find the capital: Cash 12,000 rupees; Bank 18,000 rupees; Debtors 25,000 rupees; Furniture 30,000 rupees; Purchases 60,000 rupees; Salaries 15,000 rupees; Rent 6,000 rupees; Drawings 4,000 rupees; Sales 95,000 rupees; Creditors 20,000 rupees; Capital?
Debit column: 12,000 plus 18,000 plus 25,000 plus 30,000 plus 60,000 plus 15,000 plus 6,000 plus 4,000 equals 1,70,000 rupees.
Credit column without capital: Sales 95,000 plus Creditors 20,000 equals 1,15,000 rupees.
Capital is a credit balance: 1,70,000 minus 1,15,000 equals 55,000 rupees.
Trial balance totals: Debit 1,70,000 rupees equals Credit 1,70,000 rupees.
So the answer is Capital equals 55,000 rupees; trial balance totals 1,70,000 rupees.
